recommendations.title: `_resolve_risk_declaration()` in `plan_tool/create.py` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe create r
recommendations.body: `_resolve_risk_declaration()` in `plan_tool/create.py` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe create recovery boundary”) restores a matching interactive checkpoint before `_choose_risk_declaration()` can observe `EOFError`; a TTY resume with EOF therefore replays a saved accepted low/high declaration instead of recording the required silent `standard` declaration.
recommendations.suggested_action: establish EOF as a silent decision mode before checkpoint replay and bypass the interactive declaration checkpoint in that mode

recommendations.title: `_normalize_risk_profile_proposal()` in `plan_tool/create.py` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe c
recommendations.body: `_normalize_risk_profile_proposal()` in `plan_tool/create.py` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe create recovery boundary”) returns the standard fallback for a blank rationale before validating the proposal’s tier, floor, or admission shape, so an out-of-contract `high` or non-enum proposal is silently published as standard instead of failing before publication.
recommendations.suggested_action: validate the closed proposal contract before applying the malformed-rationale standard fallback

recommendations.title: `## Source map` in `docs/CREATE_RESUME_FLOW.md` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe create recovery
recommendations.body: `## Source map` in `docs/CREATE_RESUME_FLOW.md` (step 3 “Resolve a bounded operator declaration and safe create recovery boundary”) names an `Exit code 3` and `_RC_ITERATION_INCOMPLETE`, while `cmd_create()` returns `0` for iteration-incomplete creates and the CLI tests pin that behavior.
recommendations.suggested_action: update the source-map row to describe `cmd_create`’s exit-0 iteration-incomplete result
